Behind the content

More than a creator.

As a Wisconsin-licensed attorney and content creator, I bring a unique perspective to the digital space. I earned my undergraduate degree from the University of Wisconsin–Madison and my Juris Doctor from Marquette University Law School.

Beyond my legal career, I am passionate about creating engaging, relatable content across sports, lifestyle, beauty, gaming and more. I enjoy partnering with brands that align with my interests and resonate with my audience, while bringing my own personality and creativity to every collaboration.

Available for sponsored social content, UGC, event coverage, brand activations and PR opportunities.
